pairs: The Praise of a Canticle, of David himself.
Come, let us exult in the Lord.
Let us shout joyfully to God, our Savior.
Let us anticipate his presence with confession,
and let us sing joyfully to him with psalms.
For the Lord is a great God
et rex magnus super omnes deos.
and a great King over all gods.
Quia in manu ejus sunt omnes fines terræ,
For in his hand are all the limits of the earth,
and the heights of the mountains are his.
and his hands formed the dry land.
et ploremus ante Dominum qui fecit nos:
and let us weep before the Lord who made us.
quia ipse est Dominus Deus noster,
For he is the Lord our God,
and we are the people of his pasture
and the sheep of his hand.
If today you hear his voice,
according to the day of temptation in the wilderness,
though they had seen my works.
Quadraginta annis offensus fui generationi illi,
For forty years, I was offended by that generation,
These have always strayed in heart.
Et isti non cognoverunt vias meas:
And these have not known my ways.
So I swore in my wrath:
They shall not enter into my rest.
